# Full-stack development: backend architecture, API design and frontend integration

Curated by Skill Harbor — @minimax-ai's full-stack development playbook: a mandatory 5-step workflow the agent must follow before writing any code — gather requirements (stack, service type, database, integration, real-time, auth), state architectural decisions (feature-first vs layer-first, API client approach, auth strategy, real-time method), scaffold from two checklists (backend service: typed config with fail-fast env validation, typed error hierarchy, structured logging, migrations, input validation, health checks, graceful shutdown, CORS with explicit origins; frontend-backend integration: typed API client, base URL from env, token interceptors, loading states, shared types), then implement, test and hand off. Thirteen pattern sections cover project structure (controller → service → repository, feature-first layout), configuration, error handling, database access (N+1 prevention, transactions, pooling), API clients (typed fetch, React Query, tRPC, OpenAPI codegen), JWT auth with transparent refresh and RBAC, logging, idempotent background jobs, caching, presigned-URL file uploads, real-time (polling vs SSE vs WebSocket decision table), cross-boundary error mapping, and production hardening — plus deep-dive references for testing strategy, release checklist, technology selection, Django, API design, DB schema and auth flows, with TypeScript, Python and Go examples. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via...
